summary: Preview-only PR17 prototype: render an isolated synthetic version 2 sidebar through fractal-sidebar projection and the ratatui widget, preserving the existing live version 1 path

replay.detail: No replay, migration, or backfill; the fixture exists only in demo memory.

schema.detail: No graph, daemon, storage, or preference schema changes.

rules.detail: No admission or checkpoint changes. This is not production PR17 activation.

compatibility.detail: Normal --demo and live connections retain version 1 behavior. The opt-in preview uses five folders, including two nested folders, with 30 invented agent/mission catalog entries and 29 live ordered memberships; the retired catalog entry is hidden.

downtime.detail: No daemon or live data access is required.

manual.detail: Launch fractal tui --demo --sidebar-v2-preview. Add --dump for a text frame. The preview supports folding, filtering, scrolling, and resource navigation but is read-only. Live v2 paging, edit journaling, and write protocols are not wired.

recovery.detail: Exit the demo and omit --sidebar-v2-preview to return to the unchanged version 1 presentation. No live resource writes or confirmed-base persistence occur.
